plugins.name: deep-research
plugins.description: Deep, multi-source, fact-checked research for Claude Cowork — fan-out web search, fetch, adversarial red-team verification, and fully cited synthesis using only built-in web tools. No API keys or paid search providers. Slash commands: /deep-research plus quick/standard/deep/ultradeep mode aliases.

plugins.name: deep-research-mcp
plugins.description: Deep, multi-source, fact-checked research for Claude Cowork using the Firecrawl and/or Exa MCP connectors — fan-out search, scrape, adversarial verification, and fully cited synthesis. The MCP-powered sibling of deep-research; use when a Firecrawl/Exa connector is enabled. Slash command: /deep-research-mcp.
